newsitem.title: USA: CME Dec live cattle down sharply on fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CME Dec live cattle down sharply on fund selling.

text.p: CME December live cattle futures were sharply down in late trade, depressed by fund long liquidation and weaker prices in the cash market.
Dealers noted cash trade in both Kansas and Texas on Monday at $67.00 per cwt, down $2.00 from trade last Thursday.
At 1259 CST Dec was off 1.125 cent at 65.850 cents. Other months were down 0.700 to 0.025 cent.
Prices had initially fallen following a bearish USDA cattle-on-feed report, issued after the close Friday.
The monthly USDA report showed feedlot supplies at 101 percent of a year ago with placements on feed running at 111 percent, both above the high end of estimates.
Marketings at 93 percent of last year, under the low end of projections, added to weakness in boxed beef to keep December pressured, traders said.
